newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Isuzu unit says tax exemption should stay.
newsitem.headline: Isuzu unit says tax exemption should stay.

text.p: Isuzu Philippines Corp, a unit of Isuzu Motors Ltd of Japan, on Thursday urged retention of the excise tax exemption for locally produced Asian Utility Vehicles (AUVs) or mini-trucks.
"The AUVs are being used by businessmen. It is versatile and has a good chance at the export market," Isuzu Philippines executive vice president Hiroshi Ishino told reporters.
The government plans to impose a 5.0 to 15.0 percent excise tax on AUVs as part of its comprehensive tax reform programme.
Ishino said Philippine-made AUVs had a good chance to be marketed overseas since only Taiwan and Indonesia were manufacturing AUVs in the region.
